chronology.global_freeze: Freeze/read back2025 family/control forecasts before2025 full labels may enter2026 training; freeze/read back all candidate/control forecasts before the single evaluation phase. Rolling history reads project only rows strictly prior to their particular forecast cutoff.
chronology.observability: UTC estimation-consumption receipts precede shared arithmetic estimation; durable/readback FORECASTS_2025 frozen_at precedes2026 estimation/2025full-label extension; GLOBAL_FORECAST_FREEZE and EVALUATION_CONSUMED UTC precede single grading phase. Rolling earlier2025 labels legitimately read for later2025 forecasts, so no total2025-unread claim.
chronology.original_source_clocks: Retain authentic original capture/publication uncertainty; original-clock unsupported rows abstain rather than borrow reconstructed claims
chronology.protected_outcomes: 2026 Week7+ and all protected future inputs/outcomes closed; no source/network
chronology.source_lane: Current-vintage reconstruction using unchanged original query cutoff and seven-day assumed label lag
chronology.source_selection: Accepted current-vintage qualified W1–6 2026 labels are authoritative for every new arm/control; old unqualified outcomes are not decoded. No original historical publication claim.
chronology.strict_history_rule: Every used label has prior kickoff and declared outcome_available strictly before that query cutoff; equality excluded; no same-game or later outcome. Retain original seven-day availability assumptions, no claim of historical publication proof.

year_fit_rules.2026: Supported earlier seasons2019–2025, all available before earliest2026 query cutoff

evaluation.paired_comparison: Report every family/control on the same eligible label pool; never compare different resolved-only cohorts as an algorithm gain. Preserve all losses and worsened bias/tails.
evaluation.per_week_source_coverage: Report all offered weekly QB rows, supported played counts, unknown, DNP, played missing, label reasons. Partial participation must be prominent.
evaluation.selection: No winner-based recipe changes, no deployment/promotion/default switch

evaluation.uncertainty: Fixed per-game and all offered per-week paired MSE/MAE deltas plus min/max/median observed week MSE delta; no CI, bootstrap or significance claim.

families.status: NEW exact design, not an original recovered recipe
families.warm_formula: Arithmetic mean of all eligible supported played passing-attempt observations for the same canonical player in query season before cutoff; no shrinkage in warm branch

families.status: NEW exact two-season pool, no claimed original parameters
families.warm_formula: Arithmetic mean of eligible supported played observations for the same canonical player in query season and immediately prior season, equal weight per appearance

families.parameter_origin: NEW predeclared fixed choice before any new numerical work, not user-original or chosen from2025 losses
families.warm_formula: Same-player eligible supported played history from2019 through query season; weights2**(-(query_cutoff-prior_kickoff).total_seconds()/(86400*365)); weighted arithmetic mean. Use older history when no current-season record exists.

families.exact_existing_formula: Earlier training global share=sum(y)/sum(positive finite lagged team attempts); role share=(sum_role_y+90*global_share)/(sum_role_lagged_team_attempts+90). Query H3 player/team share mixed with role prior using min(n3,3)/(min(n3,3)+3), clipped share[0,1], multiplied by lagged team attempts. Existing recent mean fallback remains explicit. Procedure-native qualified older lagged H3 remains usable; no forced current-year cold override.
families.new_parameters_fitted: Two fold-specific prior/share estimation pipelines, including shared cold mean; no optimizer, no within-year refit
families.parameters: Existing shared engine90 and3 constants, not missing original two-season method parameters
families.query_state: Unchanged lagged QB role/H3 mean+support/team-volume feature columns and strict source clocks; no actual current team volume
families.shared_engine: nfl_lab.models._workload with targetpass_att and same supported annual earlier QB fold, via existing shared model fit/predict entry

identity: Public scientific specification projection, not the complete private operational execution plan
parameter_origin: All new window/decay choices are explicit new preregistered designs, not recovered parameters. Workload constants are the existing shared engine3/90. No2025 performance used for choices.

shared_cold_policy.consequence: F1 is current-season-only in its warm branch with older shared cold fallback; never call its all-row procedure purely current-season. Report procedure-native fallback masks and current-year-history warm/cold diagnostic cohorts.
shared_cold_policy.current_only_empty_window: F1 uses the disclosed earlier-only training QB arithmetic mean only when its current-season player window has no supported values
shared_cold_policy.extra_common_cold_controlled_ablation: NONE in this bounded pilot; do not add output arms or suppress older-history benefit
shared_cold_policy.history_unknowns: Missing/unknown/DNP are never zero-valued target observations; keep state/coverage. Supported played0 stays in means. No playing inferred from active roster.
shared_cold_policy.native_history_fallbacks: F2 uses eligible prior+current player history even in Week1; F3 uses eligible multi-season weighted player history; each uses the SAME older QB mean value only when its own window is empty
shared_cold_policy.same_population: All four procedures forecast the SAME original offered rows/cutoffs; native availability/fallback masks are part of each full procedure, not standardized away
shared_cold_policy.workload_native_fallback: F4 retains the actual shared earlier-trained relation evaluated at eligible lagged H3/role/team-volume state, including older-season H3. Its declared existing recent fallback can use that qualified older history. No forced current-season cold override.
